trainer.dialogueBefore: Swimmer Glenn: Round and round the bay I go. You're the first thing all day worth stopping for!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Swimmer Glenn: Right. Round and round again.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Swimmer Joanna: I ride out here on my Lapras every morning. Race you! No? A battle, then!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Swimmer Joanna: I ought to have held out for the race.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Swimmer Kurt: Careful, the rocks out here are thick with pincers! Most of them are mine!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Swimmer Kurt: Nipped in the bud.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Swimmer Sophia: Up and down, up and down. The swell out here rocks me half to sleep. Wake me up!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Swimmer Sophia: Wide awake now, thank you.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Swimmer Sam: The Resort Area's that way, the Fight Area's the other. I never could choose, so here I float!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Swimmer Sam: The resort, then. I need a lie down.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Swimmer Mallory: My Pokémon skate over the water without so much as a ripple. Try to keep up!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Swimmer Mallory: You made rather a splash.
